prompt: What is the difference between a static method and an instance method?
choices: Static methods are faster; instance methods are thread-safe
Static methods belong to the class and can be called without an object; instance methods require an object
Instance methods can access static fields; static methods cannot
explanation: Math.sqrt(4) — Math.sqrt is static, called on the class. list.size() — size() is an instance method called on a specific ArrayList object. Static methods cannot use 'this' or access non-static fields directly.
